hero.heading: Build the deck you mean, then see it through.
hero.subtitle: MagicAIBuilder is a Commander-first workspace for searching cards, shaping a list, checking the details, goldfishing turns, and keeping the cards you need in view.
hero.note: Begin as a guest. Keep decks private, or share a read-only link when you are ready.

atlas.heading: Your Commander field guide
atlas.introduction: Follow one deck from first search to a table-ready list. Each stop names work you can do in MagicAIBuilder today.

build.title: Build the list
build.description: Search card data, choose a printing, and organize commanders, the main deck, sideboard, and considering zone in a visual editor.
build.detail: Check Commander color identity, deck size, bracket guidance, budget warnings, and Game Changers as the list takes shape. Bring in text or supported Moxfield and Archidekt URLs; export finished lists for Moxfield, Archidekt, Arena, MTGO, or plain text.

collect.title: Know what you own
collect.description: Keep a collection by printing, compare owned and missing copies against a deck, and see known card costs without treating every edition as the same card.
collect.detail: Build a shopping list for missing cards, export a collection plan, or generate localized, print-ready proxy sheets when you need table copies.

playtest.title: Goldfish before game night
playtest.description: Run opening hands, London mulligans, turns, phases, life, counters, and game zones from a saved deck before you sit down to play.
playtest.detail: Record a session and compare deck snapshots with turn-by-turn evidence, including draw progression and opening-hand signals.

share.title: Share the work
share.description: Keep a deck private while it is in progress, publish a read-only link when it is ready, and discover community decks by commander, ratings, reviews, and votes.
share.detail: Use the Game Changers list and comprehensive rules reference alongside your deck work. They are references, not predictions about what to play.

cta.heading: Start with the cards and questions you already have.
cta.subtitle: Open a guest deck to explore the workspace, or return to your private decks and pick up where you left off.
